item.text: Dear Volunteer Coordinator, I’m looking forward to helping during the busy exhibition weekend. Because I can become overwhelmed in very crowded, noisy settings, could I please be assigned to a quieter role, such as gallery monitoring, visitor information in a less-trafficked area, or behind-the-scenes support? I’m eager to contribute reliably and will happily take on any tasks that best support the team while allowing me to work effectively. Thank you for your understanding and consideration.
